semanticChecks.detail: All candidates are bound to the exact current paired-deck source/current target; source and target segments concatenate exactly; held segments equal source.

Exact crop names and young qualifier remain; the draft phrase “di ameha habonolo ke serame (frost)” carries the sensitivity meaning; keep-away direction, known low-pocket condition and observe-local-frost-before-planting remain.
Existing clear/still opening retained, full cold-air/can/downhill/collection clause exact English, colder-than-nearby comparison preserved with localized demonstrative/modal.
The exact definition and ice-forming surface, Mist-alone limitation, negative diagnostic, and can/without-visible-ice condition are preserved.
Existing check action order remains; cold OR damage and longest are retained; keep-away instruction and observed-pocket condition remain exact.
Only “These plants” is newly localized; existing predicate is preserved byte-for-byte; uncertain patch/design sentence remains exact English.
The paired slide source includes “the soil” while canonical learner source omits “the”; proposal remains paired-source exact and does not normalize or copy the rest wholesale.

limitations: The VE slide 18 paired source says “whether the soil is compacted”; canonical learner English says “whether soil is compacted.” The proposed deck text remains bound to the paired source and holds the source-sensitive check sentence unchanged. This is a one-word source discrepancy, not evidence to rewrite canonical or deck source.
Review validates source/target composition and named meaning conditions; it does not claim fluent approval or facilitator review. No repository files were changed.
